doc.citation: García Muro, V.J., Rubinstein, C.V., Pereira, E., Bergamaschi, S., Mendlowicz Mauller, P. and Steemans, P. (2020). Early Devonian miospores and organic geochemistry from the Alto Garças Sub-basin (Paraná Basin), Brazil: Biostratigraphic, paleogeographical and paleoenvironmental implications. Review of Palaeobotany and Palynology 274, 104150.
doc.comment: Detailed study of 27 Jaciara samples, following the preliminary investigation by Mendlowicz Mauller et al. (2007), Palynostratigraphic results on the Devonian of the Alto Garças Sub-basin (Paraná Basin – Brazil). The paper claims 70 miospore species; Figure 3 contains 64 taxon rows. Figure, appendix and plate identifications conflict in several places; source-specific records and discrepancies are retained below. Grey Figure 3 cells are questionable occurrences, not absences. Illustrated means that the paper explicitly assigns an illustrated specimen to that sample; conflicting assignments are noted. Monolete miospores are retained alongside cryptospores and trilete spores. The uppermost age is tentative. Comparison assemblages cited from Grahn et al. (2010a, 2010b, 2013) are identified as secondary reports. The unallocated Jaciara list overlaps the sampled section and is not additional sampling. DOI is printed in the paper; live Crossref verification was unavailable.

items.formation: Chapada Group Unit 2 (lower part), equivalent to the Ponta Grossa Formation
items.age_basis_detail: Ems Biozone from Brazil and PoW Su Biozone from Europe, cited from Grahn et al. (2010a).
items.notes: Secondary report from Grahn et al. (2010a), Palynostratigraphy of the Chapada Group and its significance in the Devonian stratigraphy of the Paraná Basin, south Brazil. An assemblage similar to Jaciara is reported without a taxon list here. Taxa of the middle and upper Jaciara section are said to be lacking, suggesting a possible hiatus. The sample-number endpoints do not establish how many samples were analysed.
